articles.title: "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" Officially Opens
articles.summary: PR Newswire: "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" Officially Opens. Organized by Exhibition Group, the "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" opens today and runs until January 19 (Friday to Monday) at Hall 5,7,9 of AsiaWorld-Expo, marking a new annual mega event combining shopping and entertainment in Hong Kong.
